question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrower exec-only SecretRef `agents.list[].tools.exec.*` contract, or prefer the broader `agents.list[].env` child-process contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96229?
rationale: Both open PRs change public config and credential-handling boundaries, and automation cannot choose the permanent API/security contract for agent-scoped subprocess environments.

options.title: Choose contract before merge
options.body: Resolve broad per-agent env versus exec-only SecretRef env first, then require the selected PR to match that decision with proof and a conflict-free head.

options.title: Accept exec-only SecretRefs
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical scoped exec credential surface and route broader subprocess env requests elsewhere or to follow-up product work.

options.title: Prefer broad child-process env
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96229 as the primary implementation path and preserve any useful hardening ideas from this branch there.

recommendation.title: Choose contract before merge
recommendation.body: Resolve broad per-agent env versus exec-only SecretRef env first, then require the selected PR to match that decision with proof and a conflict-free head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available area-history signal for the config/runtime/security contract decision and appear in recent relevant file history.
